name: Next.js Jamstack site
description: A static Next.js site exported to HTML: a blog, portfolio, or landing page, with Markdown content edited in Sveltia CMS at /admin. The sample blog is kept or removed to fit your site. Deploys to Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages.
prompts: My personal blog with an About page
A portfolio with a Projects collection I can edit in the CMS
A landing page for my coffee shop with the menu editable in the CMS
A company blog in English and Vietnamese

questions.question: Which languages should the site have?

setup.instructions: `locales`: the site starts in English. For every other language picked or typed, add it with the add-locale skill (two-letter codes only: vi, ja, zh, ...); for "English only" change nothing.
